heading: JAC Class 8th to 12th Question Bank & Exam Updates 2026 – 2027

data: Jharkhand Academic Council (JAC) and JCERT have issued updates regarding Class 8th to 12th question banks, syllabus, and board exam preparation for the 2026–2027 session. Candidates and students from Class 8th to 12th can review class-wise details, exam formats, preparation guidelines, and important links below.

Important Highlights (Class 8th to 12th):
• Academic Session: 2026 – 2027
• Question Bank Release: JCERT / JAC
• Curriculum Basis: NCERT & JCERT / JAC Recognized Textbooks
• Syllabus Coverage: Full Syllabus as prescribed for 2026–2027
• Exam Mode & Pattern: Written / Answer Booklet & Objective/Subjective mix per class guidelines
• Target Group: Students & Teachers of Government and Private Schools (Class 8 to 12)

Subjects Covered Across Classes 8th to 12th:
• Languages: Hindi, English, Sanskrit, and regional/other prescribed languages
• Core / Stream Subjects: Mathematics, Science, Social Science (Class 8–10) & Arts, Science, Commerce subjects (Class 11–12)

Class 8th to 10th Preparation & Exam Notes:
• Prepared on the latest pattern and revised/prescribed syllabus for session 2026–2027
• Class 8th board exam includes MCQ, VST, short, and long answer questions written on the answer booklet
• Class 10th students should focus on full NCERT/JCERT textbook exercises and model question sets
• Helpful for both school assessments and annual board examinations

Class 11th & 12th Preparation & Exam Notes:
• Aligned with NCERT and JCERT/JAC prescribed textbooks for session 2026–2027
• Covers stream-specific subjects across Science, Commerce, and Arts
• Useful for practicing objective and descriptive questions in line with JAC examination standards
• Teachers and students are advised to align study plans with the latest syllabus

Important Instructions:
• Prepare strictly according to the latest JAC / JCERT syllabus for 2026–2027
• Practice both objective and descriptive questions thoroughly
• Verify subject codes and stream requirements before downloading study material
• Keep official updates, notices, and timetables bookmarked for timely reference
